applies_to: action tokens of a skill in a course's own catalog (action_types; the older ability field where a skill has no tokens)

rules.rationale: The target is stating a fact or definition from memory.
The target is explaining a mechanism or reason in words.
The target is reading meaning from a result, figure or situation.
The target is choosing the approach, not carrying it out.
The target is carrying out a calculation to a value.
Deriving a relation mixes setting up the model and carrying out the algebra. The catalog does not record which part was observed, so it is not assigned to either.
Designing is not by itself coding, method choice or transfer; the catalog does not say which the target requires.
Critiquing may rest on interpretation or on explanation; the catalog does not separate them.
Marks a target that combines several actions; a combined target is not evidence about one facet.

combined_rule: A skill with more than one action token is one combined target. Its observations are reported as combined and are not divided among facets.
coding_rule: No action token is read as coding or execution. A skill is counted under that facet only when a course catalog marks it so explicitly.
absence_rule: A missing error tag is never read as success in a facet.
